from: July book, night 6 (The Still Small Voice)
p1: Elijah felt tired and sad. He thought he was all alone. He lay under a desert tree. An angel touched him and said, “Get up and eat.” Bread and water were by his head!
Then Elijah walked to a mountain cave. The Lord said, “Go out and stand on the mountain.”
A big wind broke the rocks, but the Lord was not in the wind. Then the ground shook. The Lord was not there either.
p2: Next came a fire. The Lord was not in the fire. Then came a still, small voice, soft as a whisper. Elijah covered his face and stepped out to listen.
Heavenly Father speaks to us softly too, through the Holy Ghost. Tonight, lie still and listen to your quiet heart.
old: Elijah was tired and scared and ran far away. He sat down all alone and felt very sad. Heavenly Father sent an angel to bring him food and rest. Then God told Elijah to wait on the mountain.
First came a big, loud WIND that broke the rocks. But God was not in the wind. Then came a shaking EARTHQUAKE. But God was not in the earthquake.
Then came a hot, crackling FIRE. But God was not in the fire either. After all the loud noise came a tiny, gentle whisper. And THAT is where Elijah felt God.
Heavenly Father often speaks in a quiet, peaceful way. It’s a soft feeling inside, called the Holy Ghost. To hear Him, we have to be calm and still. His gentle voice guides us to what is right.
